title: The Service For column stays after a search narrows to own invoices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Invoices tab.
  2. Search the tab for work order 2's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Service For" column shows, reading customer A's name on work order 1's invoice.

Step 2:

  • Only work order 2's invoice is listed.
  • The "Service For" column still shows, blank on that row: whether it shows is decided before any search.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-N1: “The "Service For" column is hidden when no row on the tab, before any search, is billed for someone else.”
  • S10-R7: “The column is blank on rows billed to this customer for its own work.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
